about_the_game:
Game Description:​​

Mystic energy withers, martial arts decline, chivalry perishes in the wastelands.
Imperial power rots, corpses sprawl across the land, life crumbles within royal courts.
This is an apocalyptic age of ruin and calamity, where cosmic fury clashes with human folly.
Amidst this all-consuming darkness, will you be the spark that tears through the endless night—or the ashes consumed by the flames?

​The Orphan Player Trapped in Fate's Vortex​

One day, drowning in the mire of the red-light district;
The next, caged in a mansion of gold.

You were once a drifting reed on the Qinhuai River’s shores, swept by fate’s tides.
Then came the upheaval: Shen Yizhi, the wealthiest magnate south of the Yangtze, paid a fortune to free you from the brothel—not as his concubine, but as his “sworn sister,” bestowing you the name ​Shen Shuangshuang.
Clad in silk, you stepped into his empire of riches... and into a meticulously woven game of shadows.

Yet even Shen Manor’s towering walls cannot shield you from imperial intrigue and the underworld’s tides.
Your seemingly devoted brother hides intentions you cannot decipher.
Chillingly shrewd Western Depot Superintendent ​Leng Yanqiu;
The untamed rogue prince ​Murong Yun;
The scheming, venom-smiled Crown Prince ​Murong Jin;
The demonic, elusive cult leader ​Ye Wuhen;
And ​Shen Guhong, the silent sword immortal burdened by secrets—
Behind their allure, do blades of deception await?

Offer your heart, and you may taste betrayal; savor passion, and find poison.
You tread thin ice in a maelstrom of imperial wars, martial vendettas, and blood feuds.
Every choice binds you to these six men—and twists the fate of nations.

​Carried by destiny, you cannot turn back.​​
When the truth at last emerges, a secret shattering your very identity comes to light.
You realize: from the moment you entered Shen Manor, you were no pawn.
​You are the game’s pivotal piece—the fragile, world-breaking ​​"Ko."​​

Can you hold fast to your soul in this chaos?
Whose love is true? Whose lies cut deepest?
And what storms will your lineage unleash?

​**—From the brothels to the throne, a crimson legend drenched in blood.​**​
Here, every longing may damn you.
Every move ignites destiny’s wildfire.

​Step into the mansion. Unmask your past. Wield truth as your blade—and shatter the illusion.​​

​Character Introductions: Masters of Fate’s Board

​

​Ye Wuhen​

Cult Leader of the Demon Sect
Demonic charm, unpredictable will.
"Morality? ​I​ am divine judgment!"

​Murong Yun​

The Rogue Prince
Romantic, untamed, charismatic.
"Beauties are wine, thrones are chess—why not... share both with this prince?"

​Shen Yizhi​

The Gentle Brother
Graceful, elegant, soft-spoken.
"All shelter has a cost, dear sister... Choose an easier path."

​Leng Yanqiu​

Western Depot Superintendent
Unrivaled authority, enigmatic mind.
"Kneel to live? Or stand to die? Show me... the steel in your spine."

​Murong Jin​

The Venomous Crown Prince
Calculating, ruthless, blade behind silk.
"The roads I offer... lead straight to hell."

​Shen Guhong​

Mysterious Sword Immortal
Silent, tormented by destiny.
"This blade cannot bear the sins of mortals;
Snow stained crimson is a god’s requiem."

​Game Features​

​Stunning Visuals | Immersive Experience​

  • ​100+ Exquisite CGs: Expansive landscapes and intimate moments in breathtaking detail.

  • ​Dynamic Character Art: Live2D-powered designs by renowned artists—characters breathe, blink, and charm.

  • ​Voice Acting: Professional cinematic cast brings every whisper and vow to life.

​Epic Plot | Multi-Layered Drama

​

  • ​Complex Themes: Unravel imperial conspiracies, martial wars, and electric bonds of love, loyalty, and lust.

  • ​Grand Narrative Arcs: Reincarnation mysteries • Adoption intrigues • Jiangnan’s splendor • Succession wars • Cult secrets • Brotherhood trials...

​Depth of World | Fateful Choices

​

  • ​Unique Setting: Energy fading, order crumbling. Heroes abandon their path; tyranny reigns.

  • ​Mythic Roots: Ancient Eastern cosmology unveils the apocalypse’s origin.

  • ​Soul Tests: Survive as a shadow? Or rise as the fire to ignite dawn?

​True Freedom | Command Destiny​

  • ​Dynamic Character Growth: Shape your heroine’s heart—cold strategist or passionate rebel.

  • ​Branching Paths: Web of choices weaves divergent plots and explosive endings.

  • ​Exploration & Interaction: Roam freely, bond with heroes, unlock exclusive events.

  • ​Rich Activities: Poetry • Zither • Moonlit dances • Market hunts—uncover secrets in every corner.

content_descriptors.notes:
Adult Content Categories​
​Implied Intimate Scenes​
Utilize lighting/shadows and suggestive dialogue to imply relationships.
​No explicit nudity or sexual acts​ (e.g., symbolic representations like "consciousness-flow imagery of intertwined silhouettes").
​Non-Visual Violence Depiction​
Combat sequences presented ​solely through textual narratives​ (e.g., "characters described as hearing distant screams, reflecting war's psychological trauma").
Purpose: Critically deconstruct warfare for anti-war themes.
​Content Handling Principles​
​Symbolic Representation​
Sensitive content conveyed through metaphors:
Burning roses → ​symbolizing repressed desire
Crawling insects → ​metaphor for moral decay
​Prohibited Elements​
​Actively excluded high-risk themes:
Sexual assault, non-consensual acts
Drug abuse, self-harm
Extreme gore/BDSM
